Steps | description
Download and run the standalone SilverBullet Server binary.

--- Install/Server Binary.md ---
Steps
SilverBullet is distributed as a single server binary available for the following platforms:

* macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) (platform name “darwin”)
* Linux (x86_64 and arm64) (note that this will run on Raspberry Pi as well, but requires a 64-bit Linux distribution)
* Windows (64-bit)
* FreeBSD (x86_64)

> **note** Which file should I download?
> The [releases page](https://github.com/silverbulletmd/silverbullet/releases) lists two families of zip files:
> * `silverbullet-server-<os>-<arch>.zip`: **this is what you want**, the actual SilverBullet server.
> * `sb-<os>-<arch>.zip` — the optional [[CLI]] tool (`sb`) for scripting against a _running_ server.

--- CLI.md ---
Installation
> **note** This is **not** the server
> `sb` is the optional **CLI client**, it talks to an already-running SilverBullet instance over HTTP. If you’re looking for the actual server binary, that’s [[Install/Server Binary]] (`silverbullet`), not this. You do not need `sb` to use SilverBullet.

The SilverBullet CLI is a companion command-line tool for interacting with a running SilverBullet instance from your terminal. It communicates with the server over HTTP. File commands use the [[HTTP API]] directly. Lua, queries, screenshots and logs use the [[Runtime API]]. `sb help` gives an AI assistant or a person the space’s skills and a map of the space (see [[#`help [topic]`]]).
